metadata.description: Skills and plugins by Patrick McFadin

plugins.name: github-coord
plugins.description: Agent-to-agent coordination over GitHub issues: workers escalate through issue comments and coord:* labels, orchestrators sweep, triage, and resolve

plugins.name: tmux-lanes
plugins.description: Run and supervise parallel Claude Code workers as real interactive sessions in detached tmux: start each on its own worktree, watch for change via a per-lane Stop hook, poke stalled lanes, and reap only once the work is merged
